title: YouTube Basics
subtitle: Search, watch, and find your way around
description: Learn the essentials of watching videos on YouTube — Teachy coaches you toward each goal using whatever the site looks like today.
learningOutcomes: Use basic player controls (pause, volume, fullscreen)
Get back to the homepage or main sections

goals.title: Open YouTube
goals.goal: Have YouTube open in a browser so you can start watching.
goals.coachAsk: Help me get YouTube open in my browser and show me where I'd start looking around.
goals.doneWhen: YouTube is open and recognizable as the YouTube site (homepage or main feed).

goals.title: Search for a video
goals.goal: Find videos by searching for something you want to watch.
goals.coachAsk: How do I search on YouTube for a video I actually want to watch? Point at what I should use.
goals.doneWhen: Search results are showing — a list or grid of videos matching a search.

goals.title: Play a video
goals.goal: Open a video and get it playing (or ready to play) on the watch page.
goals.coachAsk: How do I open a video from here and start watching it? Point at what I should click.
goals.doneWhen: A video watch page is open with a video player visible.
tips: Any video is fine for this step

goals.title: Use the player controls
goals.goal: Use basic playback controls — pause/play, volume, or fullscreen.
goals.coachAsk: I'm on a YouTube video — how do I pause, change volume, or go fullscreen? Point at the controls I should try.
goals.doneWhen: The learner has used at least one player control, or the watch page controls are clearly available and they've confirmed they're done trying.
tips: Hover the video if controls are hidden

goals.title: Find your way around
goals.goal: Navigate back to the homepage or another main section of YouTube.
goals.coachAsk: How do I get back to the YouTube homepage or jump to another main section? Point at what I should use.
goals.doneWhen: The learner is on the YouTube homepage or another main section (not stuck on a single watch page).
tips: Logo and side navigation are common patterns — use whatever exists today
